BEFORE YOU BUILD A PLAN

Know what your
participation means.

Start with three questions. These answers belong in the final documents, before any real funding.

What would I own?

The proposed concept is participation in a charging business. The exact instrument and client rights are still to be defined.

Participation terms pendingReview client rights

Who is responsible?

EcoCharge is the project brand. The registered issuer and the entity signing an agreement must be identified.

Company details pendingCompany & people

What funds a payout?

Charging payments are the proposed revenue source. Costs, reserves and distribution rules determine what can be paid.

Operating evidence pendingFollow the money

A demo account does not create shares, ownership or a right to receive payments.

BEFORE YOU GO FURTHER

Questions worth asking.

See all documents & answers
Do the stations shown belong to EcoCharge?+

Ownership and affiliation have not been established. The catalog uses public location records. The future ownership documents must connect the company to specific assets.

What happens if a station earns less?+

Operating costs continue and funds available for distribution may decrease or disappear. The actual allocation of losses and any payment obligations must be specified in the final terms.

Can I take my money out at any time?+

Real withdrawal conditions have not been supplied. The demo has no actual deposits, lock-up periods or transferable investment rights. Read the access and exit terms before considering real funding.
